_about: Golden gradePhases vectors shared by apps/web/src/lib/runs/race_phases.ts and apps/mobile_android/lib/race_phases.dart (decisions § 1915). Inputs (strategy = the runs.metadata.pacing_strategy bag, spec = a meridian-aligned track as legs of distance at a pace, or a pause) and expect_verdict are hand-written; track and expected are GENERATED from the web gradePhases, which refuses to write when its verdict is not expect_verdict. Track points are [lat, lng, epoch_ms | null]. Regenerate: cd apps/web && RACE_PHASE_VECTORS_WRITE=1 npx tsx --test src/lib/runs/race_phase_vectors.test.ts. Never hand-edit track or expected.
